name: Cho'Gath
title: the Terror of the Void

Q.name: Rupture
Q.description: Cho'Gath ruptures the ground, Knocking Up enemies for (varies) second, dealing 80/135/190/245/300 + 1×AP magic damage, and Slowing them by (varies)% for (varies) seconds.
Q.summary: Ruptures the ground at target location, popping enemy units into the air, dealing damage and slowing them.

W.name: Feral Scream
W.description: Cho'Gath roars, Silencing enemies for (varies) seconds and dealing ? + 0.7×AP magic damage.
W.summary: Cho'Gath unleashes a terrible scream at enemies in a cone, dealing magic damage and Silencing enemies for a few seconds.

E.name: Vorpal Spikes
E.description: Cho'Gath's next 3 Attacks launch spikes that deal 30/50/70/90/110 + 0.3×AP plus (2.5/2.85/3.2/3.55/3.9 + ?) × 0.01 of the target's max Health magic damage and Slow by 30/35/40/45/50%, decaying over 1.5 seconds.
E.summary: Cho'Gath's attacks release deadly spikes, dealing damage and slowing all enemy units in front of him.

R.name: Feast
R.description: Cho'Gath ravenously feeds on an enemy, dealing 300/475/650 + 0.5×AP + 0.1×bonus max HP true damage to champions or 1200 + 0.5×AP + 0.1×bonus max HP to minions or jungle monsters. If this kills the target, Cho'Gath gains a stack, which causes him to grow in size and gain 80/120/160 max Health. Only 6 stacks can be gained from minions and non-epic jungle monsters.
R.summary: Devours an enemy unit, dealing a high amount of true damage. If the target is killed, Cho'Gath grows, gaining maximum Health.

Passive.name: Carnivore
Passive.description: Whenever Cho'Gath kills a unit, he recovers Health and Mana. The values restored increase with Cho'Gath's level.
Passive.summary: Whenever Cho'Gath kills a unit, he recovers Health and Mana. The values restored increase with Cho'Gath's level.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Tanky mage-bruiser who controls with knock-up Q and silence W, grows from R true-damage execute stacks.
strengths: Strong area control (Q knock-up, W silence)
R true damage execute and permanent health
weaknesses: Weak to sustained true or %HP damage

curve.lvl1: medium – E spikes and Q poke

profile.curveNote: Trades around Q landing; R level 6 changes kill threat.

Q.notes: Delayed ground knock-up, not a missile

W.notes: Cone silence: stops enemies casting their answer

R.notes: Point-and-click true damage; stacks on kill

profile.windowAgainst: Q down = no reliable engage/peel; W down = no silence answer.
